text:
katie (PM): Quick heads-up: need a final cutline for Milestone 5 by COB today. I'm worried about scope creep. Current thinking: MVP keeps embeddings cache, basic tenant routing, and dedicated capacity autoscale. Defer per-tenant analytics dashboard, advanced quantization profiles, and SAML multi-tenant polish to v1. Opinions?
omar (eng): Agree on deferring dashboards and quantization profiles. Quantization work is pretty invasive and blows up validation matrix. Autoscale + cache are the high-payoff items.
jia (eng-ml): +1. Quantization to v1. Also flag: embeddings cache needs a small schema tweak to avoid cold-key churn. I can land a small contract PR but need 1 sprint.
sam (design): If we cut tenant dashboards, we should ship a light-weight CSV export and a stubbed dashboard screen so sales/support can demo. Otherwise CSMs get stuck.
mike (product-ops): CSV export + "limited metrics" flag is fine. We should add a customer-facing note in the milestone release doc explaining metrics limitations for MVP. I'll draft.
lauren (sales): BetaCorp and GammaInc asked explicitly for per-tenant dashboards. They'll accept a pilot if we commit a timeline and a migration plan. Can we promise v1 quarter?
katie (PM): Let's avoid hard dates in public comms. Offer a "pilot slot" and internal ETA: v1 (next quarter) tentative. Lauren, can you secure pilot sign-up?
aria (cust-succ): I'll prepare a support playbook with CSV workarounds and canned responses. Also want a checklist for customers moving from pipeline metrics to the final dashboard.
omar (eng): Proposed dev cutlist for MVP:
```
- keep: embeddings-cache, autoscale (dedicated pools)
- cut: per-tenant dashboard UI, advanced quantization profiles
- defer: multi-tenant SAML edge cases (v1)
- add: feature_flag limited-metrics, csv-export endpoint
```
katie (PM): Good. Omar, estimate impact in story points and call out any migrations for current customers. Need this before PM sync at 3pm.
jia (eng-ml): I'll add a guard eval to ensure cache doesn't increase duplicate tokens. Will post PR with thresholds today.
sam (design): I'll create a stubbed dashboard mock with CTA to join pilot. Won't block dev.
mike (product-ops): Drafting milestone release notes now; will include comms blurb and internal rollout checklist.
lauren (sales): I'll message BetaCorp + GammaInc and see who wants pilot. Will push for pilot list by EOD.
deploy-bot: Milestone 5 release window unchanged: 2601100000. Update release checklist if any changes.
katie (PM): Action items: Omar -> estimate + migration notes by 2pm, Jia -> eval PR today, Sam -> mocks by EOD, Mike -> release notes draft by EOD, Lauren -> pilot list by EOD, Aria -> support playbook. I'll update the milestone board and post a short exec note. Thanks everyone :+1:
